summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a 6-K providing a supplement to its management information circular for an annual general meeting on June 22, 2026. The supplement amends the terms of multiple voting shares held by CEO and Chairman Boris Jordan by removing an automatic conversion trigger tied to a US exchange listing, effectively maintaining the dual-class structure. The company extended the proxy cut-off to June 19, 2026. While not a classic management change, the filing specifically relates to altering control and voting rights tied to the CEO, making it a governance-focused special situation. The analysis is neutral, noting the structural change to share classes.
